title: +*INTRODUCTION TO FICTION WRITING
description: Provides guided practice in crafting fiction writing. Analyzes literary fiction to develop a working knowledge of narrative structure and the writer’s craft. Explores the human condition and its relationship to changing cultural contexts by reading, writing, and discussing works of fiction in a community of peer writers.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: WR 121Z, 121HZ, 121, 121H or minimum score of 1 in 'Exam for Waiver - WR 121'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in WR 121Z, WR 121HZ, WR 121 and WR 121H.
